title: Say Bukel na Panlalaban
intro: Antis ya naamtaan na mundo so malaknab a panlalaban, agawa so baleg a subok ed pananisia tan katutulok. Sayan salaysay et manguusisa ed saray pinili na sakey ya indibidual, ya saray kiwas to so mangiiter na ehemplo parad ontumbok iran kailalakan. Manparaan kan mangibaga ed istorya na sakey a kamarerwa ya mipupuligesgesan ed baleg ya imon tan saray makapasinagem ya pansumpalan to.
clues: Kaiba ak ed saray inmunan ilalak ya nambilay ed dalin, sakey ya anak na sankaunaan a sanasawa.
Siak tan say kuyak et ingganggan ya mangiyapay na bagat ed si Allah, sakey a subok ed inkamatua mi.
Ag-inawat so apay ko, bangta say apay nen kuyak et inawat, ya amano ed pusok na makapataktakot ya emosyon.
Nansalita ak na panamagyaw ed agik, lapud inkaapag-apag na ag-inawat.
Inmebat so kuyak tekep na kakabatan tan inka-dios, ya impanonot tod siak so inkahustisya nen Allah tan say takot ed Sikato.
Anggaman ed mauyamo iran salita nen kuyak tan say inkamabulos ton mamerdona, siak so nanbilay, a nagmaliw a sakey ed saray abalang.
arabic: فَطَوَّعَتْ لَهُۥ نَفْسُهُۥ قَتْلَ أَخِيهِ فَقَتَلَهُۥ فَأَصْبَحَ مِنَ ٱلْخَـٰسِرِينَ
verse: And his soul permitted to him the murder of his brother, so he killed him and became among the losers. (5:30)
